summaryZh: Jin Zhang lab 研究蛋白激酶和磷酸酶等信号酶的分子机制及功能，关注细胞信号的时空调控。官方研究介绍明确结合遗传编码荧光生物传感器、超分辨率成像、靶向生化扰动和数学建模。
researchQuestions: 细胞信号如何受到时空调控？
methods: 遗传编码荧光生物传感器

evidence.quote: Dr. Zhang’s laboratory is interested in understanding the molecular mechanisms and functional roles of signaling enzymes such as protein kinases and phosphatases. We seek a fundamental understanding of spatiotemporal regulation of cell signaling.
Dr. Jin Zhang Affiliation Dept. of Pharmacology , UCSD
We seek a fundamental understanding of spatiotemporal regulation of cell signaling.

Combing genetically encoded fluorescent biosensors, superresolution imaging, targeted biochemical perturbations and mathematic modeling, the Zhang laboratory is investigating the spatiotemporal regulation of GPCR, cAMP/PKA, Ca 2+ /calcineurin, PI3K/Akt/mTOR, Ras/ERK and AMPK pathways, in the context of energy metabolism, neuronal activity, cardiovascular homeostasis, insulin secretion by β cells as well as tumorigenesis.
